caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your smart speaker ISN'T actually listening to everything you say? 🤯

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 When you say 'Hey Siri' or 'Alexa,' your smart speaker doesn't send *all* your conversations to the cloud. Instead, it has a tiny, ultra-efficient AI chip built right inside that's constantly listening *only* for specific 'wake words.' It's like having a specialized doorman who only opens the main gate when he hears a secret password, ignoring all other chatter. Only once that wake word is detected does the speaker then start recording and send your request to the cloud for processing, keeping most of your daily life private.
